thread:
marta: FYI during a live run of the onboarding flow I hit a weird one: tool_call args arrive as a single-quoted JSON string after an auth retry and the helper schema validator returns {}. App shows empty result tile.

sam: Hmm. Which SDK and mode?

marta: node SDK, jsonMode + streaming + tool_call helper. Repro by forcing 401 on first chunk so the retry path fires. The logged response after retry looked like: 

```
{"tool_call": {"name": "lookup", "args": "{'id': '42'}"}}
```

Note the single quotes — steps earlier used a stringify helper that didn't normalize quotes when replaying chunks.

ben: Single quotes are invalid JSON.parse input, that'll throw. Did the helper catch that?

marta: Not originally. It expected an object and fell through to returning {}. I pushed a small helper patch that attempts to parse when typeof args === 'string' and also normalizes single to double quotes before parse as a last-resort. Quick snippet: 

```
function safeParseArgs(s) {
  if (typeof s !== 'string') return s;
  try { return JSON.parse(s); } catch (e) {
    const normalized = s.replace(/'/g, '"');
    try { return JSON.parse(normalized); } catch (e2) { return s; }
  }
}
```

sam: Oof. That's brittle but OK as a stopgap. We should instead fix the transport so we don't re-emit chunks with single-quoted serialization.

olga: Parity check: python SDK normalizes at transport and doesn't hit this. Recommend we align node behavior.

ci-bot: Created issue DEVEX-1147: "node: streaming retry can produce non-JSON tool args (single-quoted)". Linked sample-app failing test.

ben: I'll add a failing integration that simulates 401 then replays a chunk with single-quoted args, so CI fails if regression occurs.

sam: Action plan: (1) helper defensive parse (marta) — landed as small PR, (2) add integration test in sample-app (ben), (3) audit retry code path in node transport and stop double-serialize / wrong-quote conversion (sam), (4) update SDK docs to state that tool args will be returned as parsed objects (olga).

marta: I've included unit tests for safeParseArgs covering string/object/non-JSON. Will keep the helper guard until transport fix lands.

olga: Good. When the transport fix is in, we'll remove the single-quote normalize fallback to avoid masking other bugs.

ben: Pushing test now. Will link to DEVEX-1147.

sam: I'll take the transport spike. Quick theory: retry reconstructs chunk from cached string template that used util.inspect or similar which emits single quotes. Replacing that use with JSON.stringify should fix it.

marta: Thanks. Quick note: include streaming path in tests; this only repros with chunked responses.

ci-bot: DEVEX-1147 moved to "in progress".

sam: I'll post an RFC diff for the transport change so we can review before a larger refactor.

marta: TL;DR: onboarding hiccup caused by single-quoted/stringified tool args on retry in node streaming path; helper guard added; tests+transport fix in flight; python parity confirmed.

sam: Thanks for catching this early, makes onboarding demos much smoother. :thumbsup:

marta: ping for PR reviews.
